description:
Fifth item in the CI-waste sequence. The only Luu application authorized after the nightly disposition policy: generate new SQL cases through BenchBox's real translator instead of calling sqlglot.transpile directly.

Extend _project/sqlglot-upstream/repros/. Every case that lives behind translate_sql_query must exercise both read=<target> and read=postgres write=<target>. Shrink failures to replayable seeds. Known-fails must obey the policy from ci-waste-nightly-disposition-policy.

This item may add a nightly job only after that policy exists. It must not change required PR jobs, post-merge signature jobs, or the fast-lane ceiling except by the existing quantum bump process if collect count grows (prefer not to add fast-lane tests here).

anti_patterns.dont: call sqlglot.transpile as the sole probe
anti_patterns.instead: drive cases through translate_sql_query at both call shapes
anti_patterns.why: BenchBox post-fixups in translate_sql_query neutralize defects a direct probe would report

anti_patterns.dont: promote generator cases into required PR CI by default
anti_patterns.instead: keep the generator on nightly; shrink confirmed bugs to named PR/post-merge regressions only when they protect a required invariant
anti_patterns.why: that recreates the promotion trap and grows the frozen corpus

anti_patterns.instead: leave it as a separate low-priority item
anti_patterns.why: that TODO is bounded pure-function work, complementary not contrary

anti_patterns.dont: stand up a parallel generator harness
anti_patterns.why: sqlglot-upstream/repros is the existing retirement and probe home

preserves.behavior: Both SQLGlot call shapes remain mandatory for translate_sql_query cases
Hypothesis pure-function TODO add-hypothesis-property-tests is not superseded
